system:
You write triage summaries of companies for a team that vets suppliers and project partners. The reader has about 30 seconds and must decide whether the company deserves a closer look.

Rules:
1. Use ONLY the facts provided. Never calculate, estimate or add outside knowledge. Copy figures exactly as written.
2. Lead with what matters most: the HIGH signals first, then MEDIUM. Mention INFO signals only if they add useful context.
3. If financial statements are missing, say so plainly. Never imply figures that are not provided.
4. State which financial year the latest figures are from, because they may be out of date.
5. Court cases that are not listed under the signals are settled, withdrawn, dismissed, or brought by the company itself. Do not present them as concerns.
6. Be neutral and factual. Do not recommend for or against doing business with the company.
7. 70 to 110 words. Plain Markdown, no headings.
prompt:
Write the summary for this company.

Structure: one opening sentence saying what the company is (name, industry, state, year incorporated), then the most important risks and facts, with the most serious first. If there are no significant signals, say so and give the headline financial position instead.

Company: Murni Bestari Tech Sdn. Bhd. (SYN-001829)
Industry: Technology | State: Labuan | Status: Active
Business: Cloud hosting and managed IT services
Incorporated: 2015-07-19 | Share capital: RM5.00m
Board: 2 director(s); 0 appointed in the 12 months to 31 Dec 2025
Largest shareholder: 84.3% (also a director)
Financial years available: FY2022, FY2023, FY2024 (latest year end 2024-03-31)
FY2022: revenue RM14.57m, profit after tax RM1.18m, equity RM9.39m, operating cash flow RM1.40m, audit: Unqualified
FY2023: revenue RM15.04m, profit after tax RM1.36m, equity RM10.34m, operating cash flow RM1.95m, audit: Unqualified
FY2024: revenue RM15.81m, profit after tax RM1.50m, equity RM11.39m, operating cash flow RM2.39m, audit: Unqualified
Court cases: 2 total (1 as defendant, 1 as plaintiff); open cases against company: 1
Risk and context signals (computed, already verified):
- [MEDIUM] 1 open case(s) against the company (pending or judgment entered), claims totalling RM126,600, equal to 1% of equity (RM11.39m).
- [INFO] One shareholder holds 84.3% of the company.
response: Murni Bestari Tech Sdn. Bhd. is an active Labuan technology company incorporated on 2015-07-19, providing cloud hosting and managed IT services. There is one medium signal: 1 open case against the company with claims totalling RM126,600, representing 1% of equity. Additionally, one shareholder holds 84.3% of the company. Latest figures from financial year 2024 (ended 2024-03-31) show revenue of RM15.81m, profit after tax of RM1.50m, equity of RM11.39m, and operating cash flow of RM2.39m, with unqualified audits across FY2022, FY2023, and FY2024. Share capital is RM5.00m, and the board has two directors with none appointed in the 12 months to 31 Dec 2025.
